config.initialization: Both arms inherit E2 epoch18 encoder, interaction, gate, hidden blocks and count-readout weights. R0 preserves all outputs; R1 copies six conditional-type rows from the old seven-set head and reuses the old cardinality residual as a direct count predictor. Common parameters match; initial predictions need not match because count-head semantics change. No optimizer state inherited.
config.training: Common20-epoch full encoder and public TabM adaptation. Both count readouts lr.001, other TabM lr.0003, encoder lr.0001. Seed13, data, wave/noise, dropout, weights, seven-set CE plus.1 marginal-count CE unchanged. Epoch0 eligible.
config.selection: 0.5 original Val mean(Single,Double,background) + 0.5 mean of that score over five noisy conditions; tie original overall ACC. One trained checkpoint per arm; Test only after selection is sealed.
config.prediction: R0 coupled seven-set logits plus count residual. R1 predicts q(0/1/2), s(PF/MB/RV|1), d(three pairs|2), then p(E)=q0, p(single)=q1*s, p(pair)=q2*d. Per-member joint probabilities averaged; seven-set argmax, no hard routing or true count input.
